title: Dow Jones Futures Rise, Oil Prices Fall: Trump Says No 'Rush' For Iran Deal
title_zh: 道琼斯期货上涨，油价下跌：特朗普称不“急于”达成伊朗协议
summary: President Donald Trump said an interim agreement is close that would open the Strait of Hormuz, but negotiations continue.
summary_zh: 唐纳德·特朗普总统表示，开放霍尔木兹海峡的临时协议已接近达成，但谈判仍在继续。

title: Oil Tumbles, Stock Futures Rise Amid Hopes for Iran Deal
title_zh: 伊朗协议有望达成，油价暴跌，股指期货上涨
summary: Stock futures were rising late Sunday, and oil futures fell after the Trump administration hinted officials are inching closer to a deal with Iran to end the three-month conflict and reopen the Strait of Hormuz. Just after 6 p.m.
summary_zh: 周日晚间，股票期货上涨，在特朗普政府暗示官员们正在逐步接近与伊朗达成协议以结束三个月的冲突并重新开放霍尔木兹海峡后，石油期货下跌。下午 6 点刚过。

title: Stocks and earnings surge, and Iran deal may be imminent: What to watch this week
title_zh: 股市和盈利飙升，伊朗协议可能迫在眉睫：本周看点
summary: With earnings season done, the stock market moves into digestion and distraction territory as investors integrate the whole of corporate data with extracurricular corporate news, economic releases, the bond market's not-so-subtle signals, and whatever distractions, surprises, ...
summary_zh: 随着财报季结束，股市进入消化和分散注意力的领域，因为投资者将整个公司数据与课外公司新闻、经济发布、债券市场不那么微妙的信号以及任何分散注意力的事情、意外事件等结合起来……

title: Uber Proposes Delivery Hero Takeover at €10 Billion Valuation
title_zh: Uber 提议以 100 亿欧元的估值收购 Delivery Hero
summary: (Bloomberg) -- Uber Technologies Inc. has offered to take over Delivery Hero SE in a deal that would value the German delivery company at about €10 billion ($11.6 billion) as it seeks to ramp up competition with DoorDash Inc. outside the US.
summary_zh: （彭博社）——Uber Technologies Inc. 已提出收购 Delivery Hero SE，该交易将使这家德国快递公司估值约为 100 亿欧元（116 亿美元），以加强与美国以外地区 DoorDash Inc. 的竞争。

title: KKR Reshapes Portfolio With Exits And Energy Deals In Focus
title_zh: KKR 重塑投资组合，重点关注退出和能源交易
summary: KKR agreed to sell Circor Aerospace in a definitive deal, marking an exit from an industrial aerospace holding. The firm completed its exit from Kokusai Electric, closing out a semiconductor investment.
summary_zh: KKR 同意以最终协议出售 Circor Aerospace，标志着退出工业航空航天控股公司。该公司完成了从国际电气的退出，结束了一项半导体投资。
